question.text: Which of the following is an advantage of commodity futures over commodity forwards?

answer.text: Elimination of counterparty credit risk through central counter-party clearing

explanation.text: The Logic: A key advantage of futures is the elimination of counterparty credit risk because the exchange interposes a central counter-party through the clearing corporation. Futures also require only a margin (a fraction of the contract value) rather than the full upfront value, and the margin level is determined by the exchange. The Trap: Customization is a forward feature. Futures require margins (not zero). Futures positions are marked-to-market and not only settled at maturity. Note: The source gives gold as an example where a small percentage of the contract value (illustratively around 5%) is collected as margin, with the exact rate determined by the exchange.
